**continue**: land M1. Before M2/M3 build its format into install and done, show the owner the ~/french overview and the game card in a question post ("does this read right?"). He has not seen the map yet.

**NOT LANDED:** this session's permissions refused `kit.py land m1-a-map-of-any-project-generated-from-its`, so the orchestrator has to run it. The pointer message was not sent either: two sessions named `board-orchestrator` exist and both have been offline for 3 days.

## Holds
I reran everything on branch `m1` at 376fa17, in a scratch worktree. I did not reread the claims.

- **Check:** `python3 -I tests/test_map.py`: **17 of 17 pass** (34 s).
- **Breaks:** I applied `sed -i 's/if k not in keep and members/if False and members/' scripts/kit_map.py` and the same test went **FAILED (failures=3)**. I then restored the file and the worktree was clean again. So the check catches the union-member join it guards.
- **The real case, ~/french, read-only:** I ran `kit_map.py --root ~/french --out /tmp/crm1/map --config <scratch carte generator>`. Result: **817 files, 78 routes, 2,565 links, in 21.4 s** (load 2.9). `--check` gave "map fresh … 2565 link checks pass" in 3.6 s, generator included. The `git status --porcelain` hash of ~/french was identical before and after (0f1f4e8…), so nothing was written there.
  - **All 3 audit bugs are in the overview's flags:** the `action.feuilles` dropped field on POST /api/jeu/action (ronde.tsx:2209, type "corrompre"), `activiteParFenetre`/`activiteParDomaine` never read, and no CSRF check on POST /api/enseignant/jeu/equipes. I looked at the French code myself to confirm them: `activiteParFenetre` appears in ronde.tsx only at its type declaration (line 134), and the action route declares `corrompre` with no `feuilles`.
  - **Game card (recheck), 3 of 3:** the first lines of `areas/feature-jeu.md` say "screens app/jeu/ronde.tsx …; writes POST /api/jeu/action …; leans on lib/moteur/faussaire.ts".
  - **One drifted number:** the overview is now **53 lines**, not the 50 the post states. The NOT READ line came later. It is still under the 60 allowed.
- **Harmonize, rerun read-only:** 435 files in 5.9 s. Line 3 says "NOT READ: 608 source file(s) … 568 Kotlin, 36 shell, 4 Kotlin script. This map covers 435 of 1043". Its git status hash was unchanged. The fix the orchestrator's real_project asked for holds.
- **Full suite (recheck):** `run_all_tests.py --all --keep-going` on m1 finished **65 passed, 3 failed** (714 s), which matches the count. The third failure was not cl44 this time but `test_cl37_usage` (`OSError: Directory not empty: '.git'` in a temp cleanup). Rerun alone, it passes on m1 (27 of 27), and it passes on the base too: a race under parallel load, not M1. On the base commit 855dc16 I ran the three named suites: `test_cl30_kit_scripts` (test_task_train_names_the_push…) and `test_train_and_task_train` (test_a_lost_record…) fail there the same way. `test_cl44_agy_runtime` passed on the base, which fits "flaky".
- **A not_checked item I could settle:** `reDemande` and `etatRegle` in app/entrainer/seance.tsx do appear only in their type declarations (lines 29 and 37), so the never-read flag is right about them. Whether they are harmless leftovers is still open.
- **A flaw the post does not mention:** a never-read flag names *every* GET route the screen calls as the source. `activiteParFenetre` "comes from GET /api/item, GET /api/jeu/[id]/etat", but /api/item never sends it (only lib/jeu.ts, lib/moteur/faussaire.ts and lib/demonstration.ts hold it). The post's own quote shows only /api/jeu/[id]/etat. Someone reading the flag could chase the wrong route. The flag is right that the field is never read; it is wrong about where the field comes from.
- **Not checked:** the build time under heavy load (46 to 89 s claimed), the Python reader on a big Python project, and the `kit.py map` wrapper and install copy (that is M2).
- **asked:** the step has no `asked` entry from the owner. His design comment (m1-owner-map-design) asks for things, links and checks that rerun. map.json has that shape, and on ~/french its 2,565 checks rerun.

## Goal
The train serves the owner's picture: a map that install draws and every part keeps true, so that "even the dumbest model could just run water through the plumbing", on any project (the French game, a vice principal's Power BI apps, a thesis).

- **The current measure is a stand-in, though a good one.** "Audit bugs flagged, 3 of 3" shows the joins are read correctly on a known-good case, and the owner's own repo passed it. Nobody has yet measured a session *doing a task* from the map instead of the 7,100 lines of hand docs (tokens read, right file found first). The goal is that, not the flags.
- **"Any project" is the weak side.** On Harmonize the map reads 435 of 1043 source files (42% unread). The map now says so first, which is the right fix, but on the owner's second project its flags cover less than half. M4's readers (Kotlin, then Power BI and documents) are what turn "French works" into "any project".
- **The owner has never tried the result.** No comment from him on M1, M5, M6, M7 or M8 since his design comment at 19:41. M1 is the train's first complete step, and M2, M3 and M9 all wait on its format. That is the cheapest moment for his correction, before install and done depend on the format.
- **Read together, the posts show this:** every step that touches the map (M2, M3, M4, M9) "waits on M1". M1's own real_project run is what found its biggest flaw (the silence on 568 Kotlin files), and the passing tests did not. Lesson K2 earned its place again.

## Verdict
**continue.** The check passes, the break makes it fail, the real case on ~/french reproduces 3 of 3 with nothing written, and Harmonize shows its unread share first.

Suggestion for the orchestrator: before launching M2 or M3, put the ~/french `overview.md` and `areas/feature-jeu.md` in one question post to the owner ("Is this what you meant by the map? yes / change …", default yes, short deadline). Also add one line to M3's or M4's prompt: "a never-read flag names only the GET route whose response holds the field".
